description: A fictional short heavy revolving launcher game prop for an engineer, chunky low-poly, held level with the launch tube muzzle forward. On top at the front one single wide dark steel launch tube with a thick chamfered steel muzzle rim around its round dark opening, one long thick flat charcoal sight bar lying along the top of the tube and the frame. Under the rear of the tube one big fat ochre painted revolving drum, a chamfered octagonal cylinder along the tube axis, with exactly four big round dark chambers open on its front face in a two by two cluster and two wide charcoal bands around it. Behind the drum one boxy ochre painted frame block with wide chamfers, one small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on its left flank. Under the tube ahead of the drum one fat charcoal vertical front handle with four thick ribbed segments. Behind the drum under the frame one chunky charcoal pistol grip with a few big diagonal ribs and a squared charcoal trigger guard. Behind the frame one charcoal shoulder stock: two thick flat struts forming an open triangle ending in a fat tall charcoal butt pad.
proportions: About 0.78 m long, 0.17 m wide and 0.32 m tall. (length : width : height = 4.59 : 1 : 1.88)
sides: only the teal lamp window is on one flank: on the LEFT flank of the ochre frame block; the right flank of the frame is plain ochre. The launch tube, the sight bar, the drum with its four chambers, the front handle, the pistol grip, the trigger guard and the strut stock are on the centre line (symmetric left to right). The drum hangs under the tube, its axis parallel to the tube.
